topic: Stretching to an eighty four month car loan vs financing forty eight months (Dwayne vs Estelle)

scenes.narration: An eighty four month car loan is a trap wearing a small payment. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in a bright clinic holding a clipboard with a long loan timeline stretching off the page, comic burst banner reads SEVEN YEARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Dwayne and Estelle both buy thirty five thousand dollar trucks.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man dwayne and woman estelle beside identical trucks tagged THIRTY FIVE THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The dealer asks what monthly payment feels comfortable.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a salesman pointing at a monthly payment box, ignoring the total price, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Dwayne stretches to eighty four months for a low payment.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man dwayne signing a loan stamped EIGHTY FOUR MONTHS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He pays eleven thousand in interest across seven years.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, an interest meter filling to ELEVEN THOUSAND over a long timeline, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: By year three he owes more than the truck is worth.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a truck value line dipping below a loan balance line, labeled UPSIDE DOWN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Trading in rolls six thousand of negative equity forward.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a new loan absorbing an old balance chunk labeled NEGATIVE EQUITY SIX THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Estelle compares total cost, not monthly comfort.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman estelle calculating total cost on a notepad beside a payment box, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She finances forty eight months through a credit union.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman estelle at a credit union desk with a loan stamped FORTY EIGHT MONTHS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her interest totals thirty eight hundred dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, an interest meter stopping at THIRTY EIGHT HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She then owns it free for three payment free years.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman estelle driving a paid off truck, a banner reads NO PAYMENT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Shop total cost and cap loans at forty eight months. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in a bright clinic holding a clipboard reading FORTY EIGHT MONTHS MAXIMUM, a healthy debt chart behind her, kids comic book illustration
